content:
The **peregrine falcon** is the fastest animal overall, reaching speeds of over 240 mph (386 km/h) when diving to catch prey.

For the fastest land animal, it's the **cheetah**, which can run up to 70 mph (112 km/h) in short bursts covering distances up to 1,600 feet.
